# Cycle 1 — Foundation: Data Assembly + Leaf Modules

## Objective

Split `data_assembly.py` (2217 lines) into 10 single-responsibility modules under `research/data/` and relocate four leaf modules unchanged into `preflight/`, `persistence/`, `returns/`. Temporary compat shims in `research/__init__.py` keep all existing imports working — no cross-module import path updates yet.

## Project vision

Restructure `research/` from a flat 15-file directory into 12 domain folders (34 modules) with strict single-responsibility boundaries and clean layering: `pipeline/` never imports `api/`, `data/` never imports `pipeline/`, `reporting/` is pure rendering. Zero circular dependencies. Bit-exact output parity with pre-migration run.

## Preceding cycles

None. All 15 original files still live flat in `research/`: `data_assembly.py` (2217 lines), `stock_selection_pipeline.py` (1947 lines), `portfolio.py` (477 lines), `_factors.py` (420 lines), `_optimization.py` (375 lines), `_backtest_plots.py` (371 lines), `_preflight.py` (312 lines), `_currency.py` (233 lines), `_display.py` (136 lines), `_report.py` (128 lines), `_preprocessing.py` (122 lines), `_cli.py` (108 lines), `_persistence.py` (106 lines), `_returns.py` (95 lines), `__init__.py` (13 lines). No domain folders exist.

## Following cycles

- **Cycle 2**: splits `_optimization.py` into `optimization/`, `_factors.py` into `factors/`, `portfolio.py` into `strategies/`, groups `_report.py` + `_backtest_plots.py` + `_display.py` into `reporting/`.
- **Cycle 3**: splits `stock_selection_pipeline.py` into `pipeline/`, creates `cli/`, removes compat shims, finalizes all imports, enforces layering rules, verifies bit-exact output parity.

## In scope

- Create `research/data/` with 10 modules split from `data_assembly.py`: `_container.py` (DataAssembly frozen dataclass), `_equity.py` (prices, volumes, fundamentals, financials, delisting), `_macro.py` (macro, FRED, Treasury yields, bonds), `_sentiment.py` (news sentiment), `_history.py` (fundamental history, delisting returns), `_regime.py` (multi-source regime merge), `_currency.py` (moved unchanged from `_currency.py`), `_helpers.py` (pivot/dedup/float utilities + REGION_MAP), `_orchestrator.py` (assemble_all coordinator).
- Create `research/preflight/`, move `_preflight.py` → `preflight/_checks.py` unchanged
- Create `research/persistence/`, move `_persistence.py` → `persistence/_snapshot.py` unchanged
- Create `research/returns/`, move `_preprocessing.py` → `returns/_preprocessing.py` and `_returns.py` → `returns/_tax.py` unchanged
- Add `__init__.py` to each new folder with clean re-exports
- Add compat shims in `research/__init__.py` so `stock_selection_pipeline.py`, `portfolio.py`, `_optimization.py`, `_factors.py`, `_report.py` continue resolving imports without changes
- Verify `ruff check research/` and `mypy research/` strict mode pass
- Remove original flat files: `data_assembly.py`, `_currency.py`, `_preflight.py`, `_persistence.py`, `_preprocessing.py`, `_returns.py`

## Out of scope

- Splitting `_optimization.py`, `_factors.py`, `portfolio.py` (Cycle 2)
- Moving `_report.py`, `_backtest_plots.py`, `_display.py` into `reporting/` (Cycle 2)
- Splitting `stock_selection_pipeline.py` into `pipeline/` (Cycle 3)
- Creating `cli/` or touching `_cli.py` (Cycle 3)
- Updating imports inside any remaining flat file — compat shims only
- End-to-end output parity, circular import verification, layering rule enforcement (Cycle 3)
- Changes to `api/`, `optimizer/`, or scheduler scripts

## Acceptance criteria

- `data_assembly.py` decomposed into 10 modules under `data/`, each ≤500 lines
- Four leaf modules moved unchanged to target folders (zero code edits beyond relocation)
- Every new folder has `__init__.py` with clean re-exports
- Compat shims in `research/__init__.py` keep all existing flat-file imports resolving
- `ruff check research/` passes, `mypy research/` strict mode passes
- Original flat files removed from `research/` root

# Cycle 2 — Business Logic: Optimizers, Factors, Strategies, Reporting

## Objective

Split `_optimization.py` (375 lines) into `optimization/`, `_factors.py` (420 lines) into `factors/`, `portfolio.py` (477 lines) into `strategies/`, and group `_report.py`, `_backtest_plots.py`, `_display.py` into `reporting/`. Wire internal imports so `optimization/` and `factors/` depend on `optimizer/` only, `strategies/` depends on `data/` and `optimization/`, and `reporting/` imports nothing from `api/` or `data/`.

## Project vision

Restructure `research/` from a flat 15-file directory into 12 domain folders (34 modules) with strict single-responsibility boundaries and clean layering. Zero circular dependencies. Bit-exact output parity with pre-migration run.

## Preceding cycles

**Cycle 1** delivered: `data/` (10 modules: `_container.py`, `_equity.py`, `_macro.py`, `_sentiment.py`, `_history.py`, `_regime.py`, `_currency.py`, `_helpers.py`, `_orchestrator.py`, `__init__.py`), `preflight/_checks.py`, `persistence/_snapshot.py`, `returns/_preprocessing.py`, `returns/_tax.py` — all with `__init__.py` re-exports. Compat shims in `research/__init__.py` keep remaining flat files working.

Remaining flat files: `stock_selection_pipeline.py` (1947 lines), `portfolio.py` (477 lines), `_factors.py` (420 lines), `_optimization.py` (375 lines), `_backtest_plots.py` (371 lines), `_display.py` (136 lines), `_report.py` (128 lines), `_cli.py` (108 lines).

## Following cycles

**Cycle 3**: splits `stock_selection_pipeline.py` into `pipeline/` (7 modules), creates `cli/` from `_cli.py`, removes all compat shims, finalizes canonical import paths, enforces layering rules, verifies zero circular imports, confirms bit-exact output parity.

## In scope

- Split `_optimization.py` into: `optimization/_config.py` (`_make_opt_config`, `_select_optimizer`, `_make_builder`), `optimization/_retighten.py` (`_solve_with_retighten`, `_top4_weight`), `optimization/_rebalance.py` (`_decide_rebalance`, `_hockey_stick_warn`)

- Move unchanged to `reporting/`: `_report.py` → `reporting/_report.py`, `_backtest_plots.py` → `reporting/_plots.py`, `_display.py` → `reporting/_display.py`
- Add `__init__.py` to each new folder with clean re-exports
- Wire internal imports: `optimization/` and `factors/` → `optimizer/` library; `strategies/` → `data/` + `optimization/`; `reporting/` → no `api/` or `data/`
- Update compat shims in `research/__init__.py` so `stock_selection_pipeline.py` continues working

## Out of scope

- Creating `cli/` from `_cli.py` (Cycle 3)
- Removing compat shims or updating imports in `stock_selection_pipeline.py` (Cycle 3)
- Layering rule enforcement across all folders (Cycle 3)
- Circular import and output parity verification (Cycle 3)
- Modifying Cycle 1 modules beyond import paths needed for `strategies/` wiring
- Changes to `api/`, `optimizer/`, or scheduler scripts

- `_optimization.py` decomposed into 3 modules under `optimization/`, each ≤200 lines
- `_factors.py` decomposed into 2 modules under `factors/`, each ≤280 lines
- `portfolio.py` decomposed into 2 modules under `strategies/`, each ≤300 lines
- Three reporting modules moved to `reporting/` with zero code changes beyond import paths
- Every new folder has `__init__.py` with clean re-exports
- `research/__init__.py` compat shims updated; `stock_selection_pipeline.py` and `_cli.py` still resolve
- `optimization/` and `factors/` import from `optimizer/` only; `strategies/` imports from `data/` and `optimization/`; `reporting/` imports from neither `api/` nor `data/`

cycle_3:
# Cycle 3 — Orchestration: Pipeline, CLI, and Cross-Import Hardening

## Objective

Split `stock_selection_pipeline.py` (1947 lines) into 7 step modules under `pipeline/`, create `cli/` from `_cli.py`, remove all compat shims, finalize every cross-module import to canonical domain-folder paths, enforce all five layering rules, verify zero circular dependencies, and confirm bit-exact output parity with the pre-migration run.

## Project vision

Restructure `research/` from a flat 15-file directory into 12 domain folders (34 modules) with strict single-responsibility boundaries and clean layering. Zero circular dependencies. Bit-exact output parity with pre-migration run.

## Preceding cycles

**Cycle 1** delivered `data/` (10 modules), `preflight/_checks.py`, `persistence/_snapshot.py`, `returns/` (2 modules).

**Cycle 2** delivered `optimization/` (3 modules), `factors/` (2 modules), `strategies/` (2 modules), `reporting/` (3 modules) — all with internal import wiring and `__init__.py` re-exports.

All 10 domain folders exist. Compat shims in `research/__init__.py` still keep `stock_selection_pipeline.py` (1947 lines) and `_cli.py` (108 lines) working against flat import paths. These are the only remaining flat files.

## Following cycles

None. This is the final cycle.

## In scope

- Split `stock_selection_pipeline.py` into 7 pipeline step modules:
  - `pipeline/_load.py` — Step 1: `load_data()` + `_materialise_clean_returns()`
  - `pipeline/_screen.py` — Step 2: `screen_investable()`
  - `pipeline/_factors.py` — Steps 3–5: factor history + IS/OOS validation
  - `pipeline/_regime.py` — Step 6: `classify_and_tilt()`
  - `pipeline/_optimize.py` — Step 7: `optimize_portfolio()`
  - `pipeline/_checklist.py` — 17-rule checklist terminal gate + output writers (CSV, JSON, report)
  - `pipeline/_metrics.py` — performance metrics + benchmark fetching
- Create `cli/`: `_parser.py` (argparse from `_cli.py`) + `_main.py` (thin `main()` orchestrator + `__main__` guard)
- Remove ALL compat shims from `research/__init__.py`
- Finalize every cross-module import to canonical domain-folder paths
- Enforce five layering rules: (1) `data/` → `api/` + `optimizer/` only, never `pipeline/`/`optimization/`/`factors/`/`reporting/`; (2) `pipeline/` → `data/`(container only) + `optimization/` + `factors/` + `returns/` + `reporting/` + `optimizer/`, never `api/`; (3) `cli/` → `pipeline/` + `data/`, no business logic; (4) `reporting/` → no `api/` or `data/`; (5) `returns/` → `optimizer/` only, `preflight/` + `persistence/` → `api/` only
- Verify zero circular imports: `python -c "import research"` succeeds
- Run end-to-end pipeline, confirm bit-exact output parity: charts (6 types), `report.md`, `metrics.json`, `weights.csv` identical to pre-migration run
- Verify `ruff check research/` and `mypy research/` strict mode pass
- Remove `stock_selection_pipeline.py` and `_cli.py` from `research/` root

## Out of scope

- Modifying any module outside `pipeline/` and `cli/` beyond import path finalization
- Changes to `api/`, `optimizer/`, scheduler shell scripts
- New features or behavior changes — pure structural migration
- Adding new tests beyond output parity verification

## Acceptance criteria

- `stock_selection_pipeline.py` (1947 lines) decomposed into 7 modules under `pipeline/`, each ≤600 lines (target ≤500)
- `_cli.py` decomposed into `cli/_parser.py` and `cli/_main.py`
- `pipeline/` and `cli/` each have `__init__.py` with clean re-exports
- All 12 domain folders present; zero flat `.py` files remain in `research/` root beyond `__init__.py` and `py.typed`
- Zero compat shims in `research/__init__.py`; all imports use canonical paths
- All five layering rules enforced — no unauthorized cross-layer imports
- `python -c "import research"` succeeds with zero circular import errors
- End-to-end pipeline produces bit-identical output: charts, `report.md`, `metrics.json`, `weights.csv`
- `ruff check research/` passes, `mypy research/` strict mode passes
- Original `stock_selection_pipeline.py` and `_cli.py` removed
